roles.Cameleer: priorities and one Camel per bundle
roles.Camel: one bundle with connected Calf workers
roles.Calf: investigation implementation and verification in one owner

routing.descendant_to_cameleer: forbidden including relays and fatal issues

authority.plan_wait: acknowledge only until owner starts planning; plan approval is not implementation start
authority.subagents: only directly authorized scope and count
authority.model: inherit actual verified caller unless owner selects override
authority.permissions: preserve actual supported caller policy; never widen or guess

learning.local_refinement: evidence-based existing skill and knowledge changes within responsibilities
learning.upstream: explicit owner-requested sanitized local handoff; no automatic sending or importing
